slides.headline: IMD: Cyclone Akvan to Cross Andhra Coast Around Noon 20 Nov

slides.stat_label: Akvan Forecast to Cross Between Nellore and Tuni
bullets: A very severe cyclonic storm by landfall
Winds of 120-130 km/h, gusting to 145 km/h
Became Cyclone Akvan on Monday evening

slides.stat_label: Akvan Brings Extremely Heavy Rain to Coastal Andhra
bullets: IMD: isolated falls of 21 cm or more
Low-lying roads may flood, IMD warns
Heavy rain also likely in Rayalaseema

slides.stat_label: Akvan's Rain Also Hits Tamil Nadu and Odisha
bullets: North Tamil Nadu: very heavy rain 18-19 Nov
Odisha: heavy to very heavy rain 19-21 Nov
Telangana: heavy rain likely on 20 Nov
slides.credit_line: Sources: IMD, Deccan Chronicle (ANI), ETV Bharat
